topic: Bubble Sort Passes and Total Comparisons
questionText:

Statement I: To sort an array of n elements using standard Bubble Sort, exactly n - 1 passes are required in the worst case.
Statement II: The total number of comparisons in an unoptimized Bubble Sort of n elements is n × (n - 1) / 2, yielding O(n²) time complexity.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies that both statements contain factual errors.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. n elements require n-1 passes; total comparisons = (n-1) + (n-2) + ... + 1 = n(n-1)/2 = O(n²).
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
